Results.ReviewText: I received my 22" Original Kettle as an anniversary gift from my employer.  I have always wanted to own a Weber and was excited when I saw this one in the catalog!  I have cooked two meals on it this week, both outstanding.  Assembly could not have been simpler.  Construction is very sturdy.  My grill came with a cover, which fits very well and should keep my grill well protected for many years.  I have already purchased some side charcoal baskets and a tool hanger, but have lots more accessories on my Christmas wish list!  This is a versatile grill that anyone from a BBQ beginner to a seasoned pitmaster would truly enjoy and be proud to own.
Results.Title: Fun Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I love Weber grills.  I have one in my camper and two more on my decks.  If you love to barbecue like me, you can not go wrong with a Weber kettle grill. Ribs, Brisket, Steaks and Roast can all be cooked to perfection on a Weber grill.
Results.Title: The Do All Grill

Results.ReviewText: I lost my last weber in a divorce, Have had them for over 30 years. This one will last me many years and cook so many tasty meals.
Results.Title: Love cooking with charcoal

I recently bought the second for additional cooking space for a party and using two at a time was just as easy as running one.  Great products Weber!

Results.ReviewText:
The grill is easy to cook on. Very versatile. The lid and lower kettle hold up well. The lower vent fell apart in under a year. And the one I have now is the 2nd in 7 years to have the cups that holds the legs in place fall off. The spot welds fail. It's a shame, the rest of the grill

Results.ReviewText: We have 9 22" Weber Grills for our cabins here at Driftwood Resort. The guests are typically very happy to see the Weber grills rather than a less expensive/less sturdy brand
Results.Title: Love our 22" weber grills

Results.ReviewText: This is what a grill should be. I bought this grill to upgrade from a cheap plain 18 inch square grill i had been using and i'm so glad that i did. This 22 inch kettle is the perfect size for cooking for my family and has enough room to cook for a small gathering as well. The grill heats quickly and holds heat at steady temperatures. Once you learn to control the vents even low and slow cooking is possible. I've cooked whole chickens, racks of ribs, and more at a steady 250 degrees and the quality of the food was amazing. I add wood chunks to the coals and it works great as a smoker as well as just a grill. I would give it more stars if i could, as i can't find anything to really complain about. I love it and use it on average of five times a week.
Results.Title: Just what i wanted

Results.ReviewText: I love grilling and the ease of use is what attracted me to it.
Results.Title: Just love the kettle!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second 22" Original Kettle Grill.  My last one (Which was over 10 years old when I got it from a neighbor who was moving) was given away to a neighbor when I won a new Kingsford Charcoal grill at out Neighbor Night out back in 2015.  It's cast iron grates rusted out and finish started to bubble and rust after 3 years under a covered patio.  It was a cheap replacement and my family bought me another new 22" Original Kettle Grill this year for Fathers Day with a cover.  I loved my original grill and sure this one will get tons of use.

Results.ReviewText: I currently use a Weber gas grill and decided to purchase the Weber charcoal grill as a backup grill and for times when I want that extra smokey grill taste. The grills are same but different, and all in a good way!

Results.ReviewText: My 22" kettle is my buddy during the weekend and some days of the week. I use the chimney starter to get everything going, and get all the vegetables and bread ready to toss on when the time is right. Sometimes I sous vide the meat prior to grilling, but my 25 year old  Weber usually knows how to do the rest. I recently got a grill pad to place on the grill, so asparagus won't fall through. The grill accessories from Weber are really perfect for this as well.
Results.Title: Charcoal is renewable.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill a month ago and have used it just about every night. We even plan on using it in the Winter months. There's nothing like good old fashioned charcoal cooking! Great quality grill that will last a lifetime.
Results.Title: Great addition to your backyard

Results.ReviewText: After years of dirty gas grilles with no flavor, cheap $49 "wanna be Weber imposters" and the "Lastgrille" made in China made out of tin and flimsy sheet metal and a thousand parts and screws to put it together along with 2 wasted hours of my life to put it together, I returned it and bought a "REAL" charcoal grille my Weber.  And why not? I do live in Webberville MI!!!  This is the Classic Weber, no gages, no fancy ash pot, just a basic simple design that works flawlessly.  I've already smoked a rack of ribs and simple hot dogs and burgers all very easy with no flare ups and cooked to perfection with the adjustable vents and easy to hang cover.  Only other tool I use is the chimney starter which fires up my charcoal in 15 minutes, while Im preparing condiments.  Cleanup is a breeze with the ash pan and after a year, I can buy another cooking grille if mine ever gets too bad to clean.  You can buy these for $20.  I can't wait to cook a whole chicken on it.  The gas grille I had is in the dumpster.
Results.Title: Tried All The Others

Results.ReviewText: I have been using a gas grill for years, I recently bought a 22" charcoal grill from Weber. I can't believe how fast and perfectly it cooks my steaks and other grilling foods. It is easy to install and good quality built.

Results.ReviewText:
Recently received my Weber Kettle as a gift. Over the past few years I had used propane for the convenience. After grilling for the first time on my new Weber Kettle, I became reacquainted with the grilling experience. The food was much tastier cooked with charcoal and the smoke from wood chips. And cleaning the Kettle grill was very easy.

The Weber experience brings back memories of summer evenings, camping, and carefree weekends with family and friends. Happy Times! 

Thanks Weber!
